kebab_example: aliyun gpdb get-saas-data-unit-usage --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id agdb-example --start-time 2026-10-20T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-10-20T02:00:00Z --api-version 2016-05-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSaasDataUnitUsage

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the undeleted SaaS service. A standard DBInstanceId cannot override it
parameters.help_zh: 未删除的SaaS服务实例ID，不接受普通DBInstanceId替代
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, and the seconds must be 00. The start time cannot be earlier than 30 days before the request time. The start time and the end time form a left-closed and right-open interval, and the span cannot exceed 7 days
parameters.help_zh: UTC时间，格式yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，秒必须为00。不得早于请求时刻前30天；与EndTime组成左闭右开区间，跨度最多7天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, and the seconds must be 00. The end time must be later than the start time and no later than the request time. The query range is not automatically truncated
parameters.help_zh: UTC时间，格式yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，秒必须为00。必须晚于StartTime且不晚于请求时刻，不自动裁剪查询范围
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies the time granularity. Valid values: hour (UTC hour) and day (UTC day). Default value: hour. This parameter only determines the trend aggregation method and is not returned in the response
parameters.help_zh: 支持hour（UTC小时）或day（UTC日），未传默认hour。仅决定趋势汇总方式，不在响应中回显
parameters.name: time_unit

Distribution.description_en: The business distribution. The items are sorted in descending order of DataUnit. Items with unknown amounts are placed at the end. Items with the same value are sorted in ascending order of scenario code, project ID, and name. The items are grouped by scenario and project ID. Items without an ID but with a name are grouped by name. Records missing both are grouped as unassociated projects. The sum of all items in the complete result equals the summary. Missing or blank log scenarios are classified as other. Scenarios with values but no configured mapping retain the original values as codes and display names, and are normally included in the total. No empty rows are created for other if there are no records
Distribution.description_zh: 按DataUnit降序，未知金额排末尾，同值按场景码、项目ID和名称升序。按场景和项目ID分组；无ID但有名称按名称分组；两者均缺失的记录为未关联项目。完整结果各项之和等于汇总；缺失或空白的日志场景归other（其他）；有值但未配置映射的场景保留原值作为编码和展示名，正常计入总量；无记录的other不创建空行

DataUnit.description_en: The exact non-negative decimal string. Floating-point or exponential formats are not used. The value is null when the amount is incomplete
DataUnit.description_zh: 精确非负十进制字符串，不使用浮点或指数格式；金额不完整时为null

ProjectId.description_en: The project attribution at the time of the call. The value is null when missing, which does not affect the total amount
ProjectId.description_zh: 调用时的项目归因；缺失时为null，不影响总量

ProjectName.description_en: The project name. For the same scenario and project ID, the latest non-empty name snapshot within the query range is used. If multiple snapshots exist in the same second, the maximum value in lexicographical order is used. The value is null when missing
ProjectName.description_zh: 同一场景和项目ID取查询范围内最新非空名称快照，同秒取字典序最大值；缺失为null

UsageSceneName.description_en: The display name of the business scenario. This name is supplemented by a dictionary that maps the original Meta values to Chinese names, and is not an SLS field. UsageScene always retains the original log value. If no Chinese name is available, the original value is used as the name. Blank values are classified as other. Different codes with the same Chinese name are not merged
UsageSceneName.description_zh: 由Meta原值到中文名的字典补充，不是SLS字段。UsageScene始终保留日志原值；无中文名则名称也用原值；空白归其他。同中文名不同编码不合并

EndTime.description_en: The actual end time of the query

StartTime.description_en: The actual start time of the query

DataUnit.description_en: The exact non-negative decimal string. Floating-point or exponential formats are not used. The value is null when the amount is incomplete
DataUnit.description_zh: 精确非负十进制字符串，不使用浮点或指数格式；金额不完整时为null

TimeSeries.description_en: The time trend. The items are sorted in ascending order of the UTC bucket start time. Zero buckets are padded for complete queries. The value is null for unknown amounts and is not replaced with zero
TimeSeries.description_zh: 按UTC桶起点升序。完整查询补齐零桶；未知金额为null，不以零替代

DataUnit.description_en: The exact non-negative decimal string. Floating-point or exponential formats are not used. The value is null when the amount is incomplete
DataUnit.description_zh: 精确非负十进制字符串，不使用浮点或指数格式；金额不完整时为null

Scenes.description_en: The scenario usage within the bucket

DataUnit.description_en: The exact non-negative decimal string. Floating-point or exponential formats are not used. The value is null when the amount is incomplete
DataUnit.description_zh: 精确非负十进制字符串，不使用浮点或指数格式；金额不完整时为null

ProjectId.description_en: The project attribution at the time of the call. The value is null when missing, which does not affect the total amount
ProjectId.description_zh: 调用时的项目归因；缺失时为null，不影响总量

ProjectName.description_en: The project name. For the same scenario and project ID, the latest non-empty name snapshot within the query range is used. If multiple snapshots exist in the same second, the maximum value in lexicographical order is used. The value is null when missing
ProjectName.description_zh: 同一场景和项目ID取查询范围内最新非空名称快照，同秒取字典序最大值；缺失为null

Time.description_en: The start time of the UTC bucket

Code.description_en: The notification code. Valid values include DATA_INCOMPLETE and DATA_UNIT_PENDING
